stem.text: Which statement correctly describes the base pairing in a molecule of DNA?

A.text: The purine adenine forms bonds with the pyrimidine thymine.

B.text: The purine adenine forms bonds with the pyrimidine uracil.

C.text: The purine cytosine forms bonds with the pyrimidine guanine.

D.text: The purine guanine forms bonds with the pyrimidine thymine.
